specs.Specific Uses For Product: Data Storage, External Storage, File Backup

features: Fast USB 3.0 with Silver-Plated Connector: Transfer files, videos, and documents quickly with USB 3.0. The silver-plated connector gives you smooth and reliable performance, with speeds up to 5 Gbps
Auto Sleep Mode Saves Power: After 15 minutes of no use, the hard disk goes into sleep mode. This helps save energy and keeps the device working longer
Keeps Cool During Use: Smart design helps the hard disk stay cool while it's working—even during big transfers. It runs safely and lasts longer
Strong and Lightweight ABS Build: Made from strong ABS plastic that's tough against drops and scratches, but still light enough to carry anywhere
No Vibration, No Disruptions: Designed to stay steady while working. It won't vibrate or disconnect, so your files transfer smoothly every time
Versatile Storage Solution: Suitable for storing movies, music, work files, school projects, and special memories like wedding photos and videos
Easy to Use with Any Device: Works with Windows, macOS, and most laptops and PCs. Just plug it in—no extra setup or software needed
1-Year Warranty Included: You get peace of mind with a 1-year warranty. It's built to last and backed by reliable support
